title: Shift dates in Lakeflow Jobs parameters with date arithmetic (Beta)
body:
Dynamic value references in Lakeflow Jobs can now shift a date by a duration before formatting it. For example, `{{(job.start_time - 1.day).iso_date}}` passes the date of the day before the run started to a task. Date arithmetic is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types).

See [Shift dates with date arithmetic](/aws/en/jobs/dynamic-value-references#date-arithmetic).
